<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
It's a shame that none of the times I found worked for Elena and David. It's good that Brad sent a list of times they are free. I need to check those times against Priya's and Marcus's calendars. I already have their calendars from my previous session, so I don't need to use the `read_calendar` tool again. I'll go through the list Brad provided and see if any of those times work for Priya and Marcus.

Brad's suggested times:
*   Mon: 11:00, 11:30
*   Tue: 09:00, 09:30
*   Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
*   Fri: 15:00, 15:30

My memory of Priya's and Marcus's calendars:
*   **Priya's busy times:**
    *   Mon: 10:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00
    *   Tue: 09:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:30
    *   Wed: 09:00-17:00 (various)
    *   Thu: 09:30-10:00, 10:30-17:00 (various)
    *   Fri: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-13:00, 13:30-17:00 (various)
*   **Marcus's busy times:**
    *   Mon: 10:00-11:00, 11:30-17:00 (various)
    *   Tue: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30
    *   Wed: 09:30-17:00 (various)
    *   Thu: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-17:00 (various)
    *   Fri: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-17:00 (various)

Let me check Brad's proposed slots one by one:
*   Mon 11:00: Priya is busy (Travel)
*   Mon 11:30: Priya is busy (Contract review), Marcus is busy (Busy)
*   Tue 09:00: Priya is busy (Board prep), Marcus is busy (Recruiting call)
*   Tue 09:30: Priya is busy (Partner lunch), Marcus is busy (Litigation strategy)
*   Thu 09:30: Priya is busy (Busy), Marcus is busy (Contract review)
*   Thu 14:30: Marcus is busy (Dentist appointment)
*   Thu 15:00: Priya is busy (Client dinner prep), Marcus is busy (Board prep)
*   Fri 15:00: Priya is busy (Hiring panel), Marcus is busy (Travel)
*   Fri 15:30: Priya is busy (Contract review), Marcus is busy (Busy)

It looks like none of the times Brad suggested work for both Priya and Marcus. I need to let Brad know this and suggest a new approach. We are just sending lists of times back and forth, which is not efficient. A better approach would be for me to share all of Priya's and Marcus's free times with Brad, and he can do the same for Elena and David. Then we can find the overlap. I will start by sharing all the times that both Priya and Marcus are free.

First, I need to compile a list of all the 30-minute slots where both Priya and Marcus are free.

Priya's Free Times:
Mon: 09:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00
Tue: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30

Marcus's Free Times:
Mon: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30
Tue: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 09:00-09:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

Now let's find the intersection.
Mon: 09:00-10:00 (09:00, 09:30)
Tue: 13:00-14:00 (13:00, 13:30), 16:30-17:00 (16:30)
Wed: 15:00-16:00 (15:00, 15:30)
Thu: 10:00-10:30 (10:00)
Fri: 11:00-12:00 (11:00, 11:30)

This is the same list I sent to Brad before. I made a mistake in my previous reasoning. Sending the list of common availabilities is the correct approach. I will re-verify my initial list of common availabilities.

Priya Free:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 13:00, 13:30
Tue: 10:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:30, 16:30
Wed: 12:30, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 09:00, 10:00, 13:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00

Marcus Free:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 11:00, 15:00
Tue: 11:00, 13:00, 13:30, 15:30, 16:30
Wed: 09:00, 12:00, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 12:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 14:30

Common Availability:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

My original list was correct. Since none of the times from Brad's list work, and none of the times from my list work, I need to ask Brad to send me *all* the times Elena and David are free. That way I can compare the two lists of all available times and find a match. This is a better strategy than just suggesting a few times.It's a shame none of the times I suggested worked for Elena and David, and that the times Brad suggested don't work for Priya or Marcus. Instead of suggesting a few times, let's share with each other all the times our respective partners are free. That way we can be sure to find a time that works for everyone.

Here is a complete list of all the 30-minute slots next week when both Priya and Marcus are free:

Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Please reply with a similar list for Elena and David.
